serviceTechnologies.title: Systems & Technologies We Use
serviceTechnologies.intro: We deploy industry-leading protocols for smart home automation. Below are the main systems we use, with a brief description and their advantages and disadvantages.

knx.name: KNX
knx.description: KNX is an open standard for home and building automation. It uses a dedicated twisted-pair bus for lighting, heating, security, and energy management. It is widely used in Europe and is known for reliability and interoperability between manufacturers.
advantages: Open standard; many compatible devices and brands
Very reliable and stable; used in commercial and residential
Wired bus reduces wireless interference and is secure
Scalable from small homes to large buildings
Long product lifecycle and backward compatible
disadvantages: Installation requires wiring; best planned during construction
Higher initial cost than wireless-only systems
Requires certified installers for optimal design

buspro.name: Buspro
buspro.description: Buspro is a proprietary wireless and wired automation system by Nice. It supports lighting, climate, security, and AV control. It is known for flexibility and integration with Nice's range of products including gates and automation.
advantages: Wireless and wired options; flexible for retrofits
Good integration with Nice gate and motorization products
Suitable for residential and villa projects
disadvantages: Proprietary ecosystem; less third-party choice than KNX

zigbee.name: Zigbee
zigbee.description: Zigbee is a wireless mesh protocol used in smart homes and IoT. It enables low-power devices (sensors, switches, bulbs) to form a self-healing mesh network. It is popular for lighting, sensors, and integration with voice assistants and hubs.
advantages: Wireless; easy to add devices without new wiring
Low power consumption; battery devices last long
Mesh network extends range and reliability
Wide ecosystem; many brands (Philips Hue, IKEA, etc.)
disadvantages: Multiple hubs/bridges possible; interoperability can vary
Less suited for mission-critical or high-security applications than wired
Signal can be affected by physical obstacles

programmingTechnologies.title: Technologies & Stacks We Use
programmingTechnologies.intro: We build scalable, secure software with modern technologies. Below are the main technologies and databases we specialize in.

nodejs.name: Node.js
nodejs.description: Node.js is a JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine. Ideal for real-time applications, APIs, and full-stack JavaScript development. High performance, event-driven, and extensive npm ecosystem.

flutter.name: Flutter / Dart
flutter.description: Flutter uses Dart to build beautiful cross-platform mobile and web apps from a single codebase. Fast development, native performance, and expressive UI with hot reload.

python.name: Python
python.description: Python excels in data science, AI/ML, automation, and backend development. Clear syntax, rich libraries, and strong community support. Perfect for rapid prototyping and production systems.

mysql.name: MySQL
mysql.description: MySQL is a robust relational database with ACID compliance. Widely used for web apps, e-commerce, and enterprise systems. Excellent performance, replication, and tooling.

postgresql.name: PostgreSQL
postgresql.description: PostgreSQL is a powerful open-source relational database. Advanced features: JSON support, full-text search, extensions. Ideal for complex queries and data integrity.

nosql.name: NoSQL
nosql.description: NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis, etc.) offer flexible schemas and horizontal scaling. Best for high-throughput, document stores, caching, and real-time analytics.

enterpriseNetworkingTechnologies.title: Techniques & Features We Offer
enterpriseNetworkingTechnologies.intro: Our team has more than 12 years of experience and holds special certifications from FOA (Fiber Optic Association). We design and maintain your networks with a dedicated system for tracking and monitoring our team's performance. Choose the SLA that fits your needs and benefit from transparent delivery. Below are the techniques and features we offer.

fiber.name: Fiber Optics
fiber.description: High-capacity fiber optic cabling for ultra-fast data transmission. We design, install, and maintain fiber networks for enterprise and data centers with minimal signal loss and maximum reliability.

cable_systemization.name: Cable Systemization
cable_systemization.description: Professional cable management and organization. Structured cabling systems with proper labeling, routing, and documentation for easy maintenance and future scalability.

closures.name: Closures & Enclosures
closures.description: Fusion splice closures and distribution closures for protecting fiber connections. Weatherproof enclosures suitable for outdoor and indoor installations with proper sealing.

splice.name: Fusion Splice
splice.description: Precision fusion splicing for fiber optic joints. Low-loss splicing with certified equipment, OTDR testing, and documentation for each splice point.

qgis.name: QGIS & GIS Mapping
qgis.description: Geographic Information System mapping for network planning. Route analysis, duct mapping, and as-built documentation using QGIS and industry-standard GIS tools.

asbuilt_design.name: As-Built & Design
asbuilt_design.description: Update your as-built documentation or design smoothly. We provide accurate CAD/GIS deliverables, revision tracking, and seamless handover documentation.

maintenance.name: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Professional network maintenance and support with excellent service. Our FOA-certified team provides proactive monitoring, preventive maintenance, quick troubleshooting, and SLA-backed response. Keep your fiber and cabling infrastructure running at peak performance.

qualityControlTechnologies.title: Quality Control & Supervision Services
qualityControlTechnologies.intro: We provide comprehensive quality assurance, inspection, and supervision services to ensure your projects meet the highest standards. Our certified team delivers rigorous oversight across every phase, from on-site inspection to compliance tracking.

inspection.name: Inspection
inspection.description: Thorough on-site and off-site inspections to verify compliance with specifications, standards, and best practices. We document findings with detailed reports and photographic evidence for full traceability.

supervision.name: Supervision
supervision.description: Professional project supervision with qualified engineers on-site. We oversee execution quality, progress, and contractor performance to ensure deliverables meet your requirements and timeline.

hse.name: HSE (Health, Safety & Environment)
hse.description: Health, Safety and Environmental management to protect workers and the environment. Risk assessments, safety audits, environmental compliance checks, and incident investigation with corrective action plans.

investigation.name: Investigation
investigation.description: Root cause analysis and technical investigation of defects, failures, or non-conformities. We deliver clear findings, recommendations, and remedial plans to prevent recurrence.

tracking.name: Tracking
tracking.description: Real-time tracking and reporting of quality metrics, inspection status, and compliance. Dashboards and periodic reports keep you informed of project quality performance at every stage.
